verdict.line: You lose if she lands Hookshot's knockup near a wall while your cooldowns are down; you win if you dump full Q charges into Ki Burst before her Adaptive Defenses shield goes up.

brief.thesis: Nothing in the numbers favors either side — 49.1% over 579 games is a genuine coinflip. The lane is decided by two mechanical windows: whether you can land Broken Wings into Ki Burst before Camille's Adaptive Defenses shields her from the follow-up, and whether you're standing near a wall when her Hookshot is up.

theirWindow.when: Her E and Q are both up
theirWindow.what: Tactical Sweep's outer edge slows and adds bonus damage, and if you're near a wall inside her 800-range Hookshot, the knockup on landing chains straight into that slowed Q-empowered auto. Back off walls when both are ready.

yourWindow.what: Dump all three Broken Wings charges and follow with Ki Burst's stun the moment Conqueror is maxed — OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to spend abilities exactly here, and the stun stops her mid-Hookshot windup.

powerCurve.note: Hookshot knockup into Tactical Sweep lands first
Both ultimates online, trades level out

start.why: Run in 94.7% of games at a 49.9% win rate over 655 games — the sustain and early AD keep you even in the poke-trade phase before Camille's Hookshot comes online.

boots.why: The primary pick at 61.9% pick rate (48.7% win rate over 409 games) — the ability haste loops back into more frequent Broken Wings and Ki Burst resets for your Runic Blade trades.

core.why: The Eclipse-first path posts the best win rate of any listed build (64.3% over 42 games) — the shield and proc damage cover exactly the trade window where you're dumping Q charges into her.
Second item in the highest-win-rate path — sustains you through the poke phase before her all-in comes online at level 3-5.
Closes out the 64.3% win-rate path — the damage-over-time conversion lets you survive her delayed Q recast burst and win the extended fight.

situational.when: she is landing her empowered autos and Precision Protocol recasts consistently (51% win rate over 145 games, the auto-heavy alternative to Lucidity Boots)
you want the alternate top-performing path (Axiom Arc into Endless Hunger into Death's Dance, 50.7% over 71 games) instead of Eclipse
the game goes long and she's stacking armor to survive your Q-W bursts

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in the higher-performing page (51.5% win rate, 41.6% pick rate) — the stacking directly gates your burst window, which is why watching your own stack count matters more than watching hers.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick at 96.3% pick rate (49.6% win rate) — Ignite punishes the all-in Camille commits to once her Hookshot is on cooldown after a failed engage.

playing.title: Track your Runic Blade charges
playing.detail: Riven's passive charges her blade off ability casts, and her basic attacks consume those charges for bonus damage — always land an auto immediately after Broken Wings or Ki Burst, never before.

playing.title: Bait her shield before committing
playing.detail: Camille's Adaptive Defenses shields her against your damage type right after she lands a basic attack on you. Take the first trade light, then dump your real burst once that shield has worn off.

playing.title: Stay off walls when her E is up
playing.detail: Hookshot pulls her to a wall and knocks up anyone she lands on — fighting near terrain when her E is off cooldown turns a normal trade into a full combo against you.

playing.title: Full-charge Q into W on Conqueror stacks
playing.detail: Wait for Conqueror to be maxed, then chain all three Broken Wings charges into Ki Burst's stun — this is the single highest-value window in the matchup per the measured data.

playing.title: Save Valor for her delayed Q recast
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's recast does significantly more damage the longer she delays it — use Valor's damage block to eat that hit if you see her holding the recast.

playing.title: Time your ult after her Hookshot is spent
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile gives you AD, range, and one Wind Slash cast — commit your all-in once she's used her 16-12s cooldown Hookshot and can't reposition to a new wall.

brief.patchCaveat: All win rates, item paths, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (579-game sample for this matchup). The mechanical reasoning — passive shield timing, Runic Blade sequencing, Hookshot positioning — is my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoiding Camille’s (E) is vital when fighting her. Use your abilities when your Conqueror’s stacks are raised to deal damage.
